fixes.find: If it is weeping from the tank seam, yes - a tank leak is not repairable. If it is dripping from the T&P valve, a fitting or the drain valve, that is a part, not a unit. Ask for the failure point in writing before you accept any replacement quote.
fixes.replace: A leak from the tank itself generally means replacement, because a tank leak is not repairable. A drip from a fitting or the drain valve is usually a part. Water from the temperature and pressure relief valve is different: it can signal excess pressure, thermal expansion or overheating, so the valve and its discharge pipe should be kept clear, never capped or plugged, and the cause diagnosed by a professional. A good replacement quote names the failure point in writing. For a gas smell or a carbon monoxide alarm, leave the building and call 911 or the gas utility from outside.
fixes.why: CRITICAL 7: relief-valve discharge treated as a simple part; missing keep-clear and evacuation guidance
